I am 80 years old and have farmed here all my life. I went to school long enough to read, so when the agro-dealer has subsidized NPK I buy one bag and share it thinly across my plots — just a few handfuls per ridge on this beans land. I put cattle manure on this plot every year because I own the land, I use my own saved seed, and I do not spray chemicals or irrigate since I wait for the rains. My family will work about 80 days here, and I will hire young men for 12 days of heavy clearing and harvesting because my back is weak now.
